subject: Re: Stratus Bank - provisioning & SSO questionnaire (SCIM, RBAC, OIDC/SAML)
messages:
From: Alicia Morgan <alicia.morgan@stratusbank.com>
To: sergio_alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Wu <tom.wu@stratusbank.com>, procurement@stratusbank.com
Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Stratus Bank - provisioning & SSO questionnaire

Sergio,

Thanks for the quick intro call earlier. As part of our onboarding / security review for the pilot, our identity team asked us to collect a few specifics about your provisioning and SSO capabilities. We've attached our standard questionnaire (Excel) and a short SCIM attribute template. Top-line items we need clarified: 

- Do you support both SAML 2.0 and OIDC for SSO? If so, what features differ (e.g., SP-initiated vs IdP-initiated, session lifetime controls, id_token claims)?
- Does Redwood provide SCIM 2.0 user/provisioning endpoints with PATCH and bulk operations? Can you map arbitrary custom attributes (employeeNumber, costCenter, orgUnit) and sync groups?
- RBAC model: can customers define hierarchical roles, and is there a super-admin with immutable audit trail?
- Administrative controls: separation of duties, delegated admins, JIT access approvals, and whether actions are logged to an immutable audit store we can ingest.

We're on a tight timeline for the pilot (targeting mid-April). Can you provide a completed version of the questionnaire and a short summary of any limitations within 48 hours? Also, please include sample SCIM payloads or attribute mappings if available.

Appreciate it — Alicia

--
Alicia Morgan
Senior Manager, Identity & Access Management
Stratus Bank
alicia.morgan@stratusbank.com

Attachment: Stratus_IAM_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx (Excel, 78KB)
Attachment: scim_attribute_map.csv (CSV, 4KB)

Subject: Re: Stratus Bank - provisioning & SSO questionnaire

Hi Alicia —

Thanks for sending the questionnaire and for the call. We're happy to support the pilot. Quick summary up-front, with a note that I'm attaching our operations doc (redwood-saml-oidc-ops.pdf) and a sample SCIM mapping CSV. We'll also fill the Excel questionnaire and return it.

Short answers:
- SSO: Redwood supports both SAML 2.0 and OpenID Connect (OIDC). We support SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows for both protocols. OIDC is our preferred integration for modern clients (id_token + userinfo), and we offer configurable session TTLs per application (default 8 hours, adjustable by customer policy).
- SCIM: We implement SCIM 2.0 with full CRUD + PATCH (JSON Patch and PATCH with partial updates). We support bulk operations for initial syncs; rate-limited in line with tenant quotas. Custom attribute mapping is supported via our mapping layer — you can map arbitrary attributes (employeeNumber, costCenter, custom JSON blobs). Group sync is supported; groups are represented as SCIM Group resources and can be used as role sources.
- RBAC: Customers can define hierarchical roles and role inheritance. We have a built-in super-admin role, but account owners can create and lock custom roles. All RBAC changes are versioned and stored in our audit logs.
- Admin controls & audits: Separation of duties is supported (role-based delegation), we offer delegated admin scopes, and administrative actions are logged with user, time, IP, and request id. Logs are write-once in our storage tier for the retention period you choose; we provide log export hooks (S3, SIEM connectors).

Open items we'll need to confirm and will include in the completed questionnaire:
1) Whether you need JIT (Just-In-Time) provisioning on SSO assertion receipt vs pre-provisioning via SCIM for the pilot (we can support both).
2) Exact SCIM attribute list you expect to sync and whether group-to-role mapping is one-to-one or many-to-many for your org.

Next steps: I'm attaching: redwood-saml-oidc-ops.pdf (short ops + endpoints), scim_attribute_map.csv (sample mapping). We'll upload a completed questionnaire within 24 hours and loop in Laura (security) and Priyom (solutions) for any technical deep dive.

Best,

Cc: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Stratus Bank - provisioning & SSO questionnaire

Hi Alicia —

I've reviewed the initial answers Sergio provided and added a few operational clarifications inline below (also adding them to the attached questionnaire we will return). For your identity team: please see the bold items.

- Session controls: When you set a session TTL at the application level, we enforce it at token issuance and also support rolling renewals. We also support configurable inactivity timeouts and absolute max session durations.
- SCIM throttling & bulk: Bulk import supports up to 1,000 resources per request for tenant initial syncs; incremental websocket/stream updates are available for near-real-time syncs if you prefer event-driven provisioning.
- Attribute mapping & transformations: Our mapping engine supports simple transforms (concatenate, substring, lower/upper) and regex-based validations. Custom JSON attributes are stored as "opaque_metadata" in the user resource if you don't want them mapped to top-level SCIM attributes.
- RBAC enforcement: Role checks are evaluated at request time; we also optionally support pre-warming policy caches for high-throughput paths. You can enforce attribute-based access (ABAC) in addition to RBAC via policy rules.
- Audit ingestion: Logs are delivered via s3-compatible buckets and via a webhook that emits compressed ndjson; we also push to Splunk/Datadog via partner connectors. For compliance, we provide an immutable, append-only ledger export on a 30/90/365 day cadence.

A few questions from my side to help finalize:
1) Does Stratus require the SCIM sync to preserve historical attributes (e.g., prior costCenter values) or is current-state sufficient?
2) Do you need support for SCIM schema extension urns (we support custom schema URNs per tenant)?
3) Any constraints on external IP ranges for SCIM callbacks or webhook endpoints (we can allowlist static egress ranges per account).

If you can confirm those, we'll finish the questionnaire and include sample SCIM PATCH & BULK payloads tailored to your attributes.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Director, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: (will include completed questionnaire)

From: Tom Wu <tom.wu@stratusbank.com>
To: sergio_alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Alicia Morgan <alicia.morgan@stratusbank.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, priyom_das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Stratus Bank - provisioning & SSO questionnaire

Sergio/Laura —

Thanks for the thorough responses and the attachments. A few follow-ups from our engineering lead: 

- For the pilot we'd prefer provisioning via SCIM (pre-provision users in a staging tenant) but would like a JIT fallback for contractors in case their accounts are missing. Can you confirm both modes can co-exist without conflicting user ids?
- We also need to map Stratus-specific attributes: employeeNumber (string), lineOfBusiness (enum), costCenter (string), and managerId (UUID). Please confirm whether redwood-scim preserves managerId references for group membership lookups.
- For audit ingestion: we prefer a continuous webhook rather than s3 dump for our SIEM. Can you provide a sample NDJSON compressed webhook payload and expected delivery semantics (retries, idempotency)?

If you can send the completed questionnaire and the sample webhook payload by EOD tomorrow, procurement will move the pilot contract through.

Tom
Engineering Manager, IAM Integrations
Stratus Bank
